hypothesis: A positive year-over-year change in single-quarter operating-profit margin captures improving operating leverage that can rank future returns beyond the matched quality-cash baseline.

factor.formula: (quarterly operating_profit / quarterly revenue)_t - (quarterly operating_profit / quarterly revenue)_(t-4)
factor.quarterization: Q1 uses reported cumulative values; Q2-Q4 use the difference from the immediately preceding same-fiscal-year quarter only when period indices are consecutive
factor.point_in_time: Each source period uses financial_pit_date's statutory deadline fallback. A derived quarter becomes available only after all cumulative reports needed for that quarter, and the YoY change only after current and year-ago quarters are available; factor begins T+1 and expires after 180 calendar days.
factor.missing_data_rule: Require positive quarterly revenue and non-null operating profit/revenue inputs in both current and year-ago quarters; otherwise null. No zero fill, interpolation, or fallback.
factor.universe: Historical daily HS300 membership excluding banks and non-bank financials using the current industry snapshot; not historical PIT.

strategy.matched_requirements: Same historical non-financial HS300 universe, factor-availability filter, basic filter, score limit 30, top 10 equal-weight positions, 20 trading-day max hold, -20% stop, T+1 open execution and cost model.

segments.stitching: Compound separately executed discovery and validation curves and skip first return of subsequent segment.

factor_ic.method: Month-end factor value versus T+1 open to T+21 open forward return, cross-sectional Spearman within historical non-financial HS300 members; at least 30 names.

gates.D1: Coverage and first-valid-date feasibility gates F1-F3 remain satisfied.
gates.D2: Same-date PIT, report-age expiry, source-quarter continuity and no-fill audit passes.
gates.D3: Maximum mean absolute monthly rank correlation with the frozen R272 feasibility comparison list is <=0.70.
gates.I1: Discovery mean rank IC >=0.02 across at least 18 months.
gates.I2: Validation mean rank IC >=0.01 across at least 18 months and positive.
gates.G1: Discovery candidate return >= control +5 percentage points.
gates.G2: Discovery candidate MDD no worse than control by more than 5 percentage points.
gates.G4: Full-sample candidate return is positive and >= control.
gates.G5: Full-sample MDD no deeper than -40% and no worse than control by more than 5 percentage points.
gates.G6: Rolling one-year positive-return rate >=60% and no worse than control by more than 2 percentage points.
gates.G7: Recent 12-month candidate return is positive and MDD no worse than control by more than 5 percentage points.
gates.G8: Full-sample return is positive under 4x costs.
gates.G9: Full-sample return is positive under 5x costs.
gates.C3: Top three symbols net P&L share <=55%.
gates.C4: Top five symbols net P&L share <=75%.
gates.C5: At least 8 distinct positive-contribution symbols in validation.
gates.C7: Largest single-symbol loss <=20% of gross profit.

decision_rule: All D/I/G/C gates must pass; any failure rejects the candidate. Results do not authorize paper trading or production without separate approval. Do not tune the formula, 180-day expiry, score weight, holding period, stop, costs, universe, or thresholds after results.
known_limitations: Financial parquet files are current snapshots and can contain restatements or backfilled values despite statutory-date fallback.
Current industry classification is applied historically.
The factor may be regime-sensitive and uses overlapping discovery/validation-era research, so this is exploratory, not untouched confirmation.
Two independently initialized system-backtest segments are stitched; a position open at a segment boundary is not carried.
Passing would only permit a separately governed paper-trading discussion.
